[I will bid my true private value of $7. In this 3-player third-price auction you pay the lowest of the other two bids, so my bid only affects whether I win, not the price. Bidding my value maximizes expected surplus while avoiding overbidding that could lead to winning at a loss. [Third-price auction: the winner pays the lowest of the three bids, so aggressive bidding can be profitable because you typically pay an opponent's low bid. With my value v=36, bidding the maximum makes me very likely to win while the expected third-price (if opponents bid their values) ≈49/3≈16.33, giving expected surplus ≈19.67.
